With a 35″ narrow profile, tight turning radius, and high-torque Yanmar diesel hydraulics, these mini skid steers reach where full-size equipment can’t: residential gates, indoor demolition, fenced yards, and tight landscaping sites. Pair your mini skid steer with Mammoth’s equipment financing and get into the field faster. ekit_accordion_items.acc_title: What is the difference between the X-Loader 120MT Turbo and the 100MT?
ekit_accordion_items.acc_content: The 120MT Turbo features a turbocharged Yanmar 3TNV80FT diesel (24.7 HP) and 13.8–17 GPM high-flow hydraulics for high-output attachments like stump grinders, mulchers, and cold planers. The 100MT runs a naturally-aspirated Kubota D1105 diesel (24.8 HP) with 10–15 GPM standard flow, ideal for landscaping, residential builds, and lighter excavation. Both mini skid steers are about 36″ wide and ship with a universal quick-hitch attachment plate.

ekit_accordion_items.acc_title: How much weight can a Mammoth mini skid steer lift?
ekit_accordion_items.acc_content: The X-Loader 120MT Turbo has a 1,300 lb rated operating capacity (ROC); the X-Loader 100MT has a 1,200 lb ROC; and the compact X-Loader 50MT has a 1,000 lb ROC. All figures come from the Mammoth product catalogue using a standard dirt bucket.

ekit_accordion_items.acc_title: What attachments work with Mammoth mini skid steers?
ekit_accordion_items.acc_content: All three X-Loader models use the industry-standard universal mini skid steer mount, so you can run buckets, augers, trenchers, grapples, pallet forks, power brooms, mulchers, snow blowers, hammers, levelers, stump grinders, post drivers, and most third-party attachments.

ekit_accordion_items.acc_title: Are Mammoth mini skid steers made in Canada?
ekit_accordion_items.acc_content: Mammoth Machinery is a Canadian company founded in 2018, and every X-Loader is designed and engineered in Burlington, Ontario for Canadian climates and job-site conditions. Canadian-based operations mean faster parts availability and local service support through Mammoth's coast-to-coast dealer network, and every machine is backed by the 5-year / 3,000-hour Mammoth Shield Warranty.

ekit_accordion_items.acc_title: What warranty comes with a Mammoth mini skid steer?
ekit_accordion_items.acc_content: Every X-Loader ships with the Mammoth Shield Warranty: 5 years or 3,000 hours of operation (whichever comes first) covering powertrain, hydraulic system, and structural components. It's one of the longest warranties in the compact equipment industry.

ekit_accordion_items.acc_title: What is the best mini skid steer for landscaping in Canada?
ekit_accordion_items.acc_content: For landscaping, the X-Loader 100MT mini skid steer is the go-to choice, at 36″ wide it fits through most residential gates, and the 24.8 HP Kubota diesel handles bucket work, auger drilling, power brooming, and tree planting without breaking a sweat. The 120MT Turbo is the better pick for landscapers running stump grinders or mulchers daily. Both Mammoth mini skid steers are available for immediate delivery across Canada.

ekit_accordion_items.acc_title: How much does a mini skid steer cost in Canada?
ekit_accordion_items.acc_content: Mammoth mini skid steers for sale in Canada start at $27,999 CAD for the compact X-Loader 50MT, $33,999 CAD for the X-Loader 100MT, and $38,999 CAD for the turbocharged 120MT Turbo. All prices include the Mammoth Shield 5-Year / 3,000-Hour Warranty and a universal quick-hitch attachment plate. Financing is available from 1.99% to 0% APR with terms up to 72 months, making a commercial-grade mini skid steer accessible for contractors of all sizes.
